svg.text: Turning an idea I find into a tested strategy
Not every idea is my own. When I spot something interesting, it goes through the same pipeline. Worked example: a public VIX-reversal study.
1 · The study I came across — research by others, not mine (headers relabelled in English)
QQQ — forward returns after the biggest intraday VIX drops
SPY — the same signal on the broad index
Public research found online: the biggest intraday VIX drops, and the forward QQQ / SPY returns — nearly every 1-year outcome green. Interesting enough to test; step one is to rebuild it myself.
2 · How I turn it into research → backtest → strategy

text.tspan: — an interesting result in someone else's research — like the tables above.
— pull the raw data and reproduce the study myself; distrust it until it replicates exactly.
— re-run on other markets and vary the parameters — a real edge survives, a fitted one doesn't.
— the raw study has no buy/sell rules or stops, so I define automatic detection, entry/exit and risk.
— stands alone → a strategy; if not (drawdown, consistency, too few trades) → a regime filter for other strategies.

svg.text: Idea → verification → stress-test → a strategy, or a regime filter. This one is at step one: spotted, not yet verified.
